notes.title: Major Fixes 0.4.2
notes.content:
[p][b]Patchnotes 0.4.2[/b] 
This patch focuses on improved options and UI adjustments, as well as general fixes/improvements.

[i]In test:[/i] 
- Controller support is now almost finished (character fully functional, UI only in lobby)

[i]General:[/i] 
- The villa is dark again now. 
- Generators are now heavier 
- The letter that could previously be found at the well in front of the villa has been removed (All letters will randomly appear in rooms gradually) 
- Made the pond a bit bigger 
- The game is now starting in fullscreen. 
- Found letters/notes should now be able to be closed with 'e' (interact) 
- The first letter is now always available in the suitcase (lobby). 
- The bathroom is no longer equipped with modern amenities. 
- In the menu/journal, the camera should not move (the bug had crept back in) 
- The player's spirit will no longer spawn upon death in singleplayer; you will immediately receive the 'Game Over' screen. The player's ghost will no longer spawn upon death in singleplayer, you will immediately receive the 'Game Over' screen. 
- Jump frequency increased (Instead of every 1.5s now every 1.0s)
[i]
User Interface:[/i]
- Lobby intro brief on PC text slightly adjusted 
- Placeholder in the description text in the Purity Skilltree removed 
- 'challenging call' text in the skill tree (Amplification) is no longer written in lowercase 
- Text adjusted for Nightwalker (Creation): 
Before: A stealth class focused on invisibility and ambushes. 
Afterwards: A stealth class focused on invisibility and preparation. 
- Text adapted for the Alchemist (Witchcraft): 
Before: A utility-focused support with potions for vision and survival. 
Afterwards: A utility-focused support with potions for survival. 
- Shop costs adjusted for Adrenaline Shot (75 -> 25) 
- Journal: Some text adjustments under "Events" 
- Added suitcase text in the lobby: 'Here you can reread letters you have found.' 
- Minigame 2 timer removed while waiting 
- Found letters in rooms no longer cause a black screen when picked up 
- Wishlist button repaired 
- Client now also has the lobby ID on the PC

Options: 
- There is now a test sound button. 
- 'Target Display' setting temporarily removed 
- Resolutions adjusted 
- Dropdowns should now close with a click on the screen.

Thank you very much for testing![/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.31a
notes.content:
[list]
[*] ‘X’ in the main menu can now be clicked to exit the game
[*] Skilltree upgrade button disabled (for now)
[*] You no longer walk when you are on the PC (but you can still hear footsteps)
[*] Candlesticks now have colliders
[*] SpookyMcGee dialog, tutorials and notes are only displayed once
[*] Selected mask is now loaded correctly on restart
[*] Players are now also affected by flashlights (shadows)
[*] Certain items no longer have a collider
[*] Auxiliary collider added in both maps so that you can't climb walls
[*] Skill: Signal (Mask: Creation)
[list]
[*] [*] no longer floats
[*] [*] destroys itself after 2 minutes
[*] [*] now has a visible border for the trigger
[*] [*] Construction sound changed
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Patchnotes 0.3a:
notes.content:
0.3 Changes:

- Loading screen now closes automatically when you enter the game
- Spooky McGee dialog only appears when you travel to the mansion
- You now have a dialog when you want to leave the game through the red ‘X’ (Lobby PC UI)
- ‘Join Lobby’ button no longer bugs if the code is incorrect/incomplete
- Added “Close Lobby” as host and “Leave Lobby” as client buttons
- Mouse cursor no longer transparent
- Volume of the track in the villa and some SFX turned down
- Fixed found texture errors (storage room wall; below the bathroom)
- Bathroom assets now have colliders
- Removed signpost in front of the villa
- UI adjustments (mainly lobby/PC)
- Skilltree UI (Mask/Class) added (test; currently not working)
- Text adjustments in the journal
- Players now have a border
- Adjusted side quest descriptions
- UI buttons (PC Lobby) should now become smaller again when clicked on
- Text: Settings
		-> Music slider now updates the music volume
		-> Resolution no longer has duplicate entries
		-> Target Display better naming
- SFX adjustments (no more sound if you can't drop an item)
- You can no longer run across the pond
- UI no longer clickable on the PC (lobby) if you have also left the PC
- Skill cooldown reduced (from 60 to 30 sec)
- camera and player in journal and pause menu now FIX
- checkboxes in the journal FIX
- close only currently open windows with escape FIX (But still about
